spell.frieren_flight.flight.desc: Ancient flight magic (人類の魔法). Grants free flight with subtle magic aura under feet while continuously consuming mana. Recast to toggle off. Prevents fall damage upon landing.
message.frieren_flight.out_of_mana: ⚠ Mana exhausted! Descending with slow falling...
spell.frieren_flight.judradjim.desc: Cataclysm lightning of Master Denken (ジュドラジム). Calls forth a colossal pillar of black and gold thunder from the heavens, inflicting devastating blast damage and unleashing an explosive shockwave that violently repels all surrounding foes.
spell.frieren_flight.reelseiden.desc: Cleaving magic of Übel (レイルザイデン). A silent, instantaneous slash that cuts through the atmosphere in line of sight. Slices straight through 100% of armor and defense, piercing and disabling shields.
spell.frieren_flight.flower_bed.desc: Frieren's signature spell (花畑を出す魔法). Conjures a vast, blooming field of picturesque flowers across a 64.0+ block radius, prominently featuring the legendary Blue Moonweed. Grants players rapid health (5.0–10.0 HP/sec), mana (+15–29/sec) regeneration, and 50% damage reduction for 50–60 seconds, while decaying all hostile monsters within the territory by -2% Max HP every second!
spell.frieren_flight.explosion.desc: Megumin's iconic apocalyptic detonation magic (エクスプロージョン). The caster chants an ancient incantation while firmly rooted in place for 4.0 seconds, before unleashing a cataclysmic blast that conjures a colossal 50m 3D mushroom cloud and shockwave, inflicting 850–1,150 damage, carving a massive crater into the earth, and draining 100% of remaining mana.
